summary: Completed comprehensive testing of Paysible fintech app. Backend APIs working perfectly (100% success rate). Frontend loads correctly and displays login/registration forms properly. However, critical frontend-backend integration issue identified: form submissions are not triggering API calls.

integration_issues.issue: Registration form submits but does not trigger API calls to backend - no network requests made when Create Account button is clicked
Login form submits but does not trigger API calls to backend - authentication flow not completing
No auth tokens stored in localStorage after form submission - React authentication context not receiving API responses

passed_tests: Frontend loads correctly and displays Paysible branding
Login page displays with proper form fields (email, password)
Registration form toggle works correctly (shows full name field)
Form field validation and input handling works
Backend API health endpoint accessible from frontend (200 OK)
Direct API calls work perfectly (registration API returns valid token)
action_item_for_main_agent: CRITICAL: Frontend form submission not triggering API calls. The React forms (login/registration) are not calling the backend APIs when submitted. Direct API calls work perfectly, but the React form handlers are not executing the authentication flow. Issue is in the Login component's handleSubmit function or the AuthContext integration. Need to debug: 1) Form onSubmit event handling, 2) AuthContext login/register methods, 3) API client integration in React components.
